amendment.decision: Context-aware native performance gates: ordinary responsiveness budgets unchanged; rebuild-window latency and rebuild-blocked rewards separately measured and bounded; macOS event-loop-lag p95 compared against its paired control when the runner baseline alone exceeds the absolute limit. 2026-09-21 (Wilson, Decision A): the same paired-control rule applies to event_loop_lag max_ms (max_control_delta_ms 50.0) — a lane passes when the runner baseline alone approaches the ceiling and addon-minus-control stays within the bound; the 200 ms ceiling itself is unchanged.

scoping_amendment.decision: endurance_memory retention (slope_mib_per_min / settled_increase_mib) on Qt 6.11 lanes is a tracked CI observation, not a release gate: evaluated as warnings via scope_endurance_failures() for nightly and release profiles only. Qt 6.5 and earlier keep failing; unparseable runtime info fails closed; the metric numbers themselves are unchanged in the payload and the scoping itself is recorded as a warning.
scoping_amendment.evidence: A2-a falsified the QtWebEngine flag pair as the cause (nightly 35692375494: flags OFF = macOS 39.5 MiB/min vs 4.0 with flags, Linux identical, no 0xC0000005 crash returned); local macOS with the same absent flags shows memory falling — the runner environment is the remaining differentiator.

note: Fixed acceptance targets from the AnkiScape reliability plan. These are not measured promises; changing one requires a documented plan amendment. Disk-full/locked-db failures are tested for safe degradation, not expected to meet normal successful-write latency.
